description: 국토교통부 철도특별사법경찰대_철도경찰대 철도안전법위반 단속통계 [railways and stations and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부 철도특별사법경찰대. - 국토교통부 철도특별사법경찰대 소속으로서 각 지역 관할 검찰청 검사장의 지명을 받아 특별사법경찰 권한을 가진자가 적법한 권한을 기반으로 행한 철도안전법 위반행위자 대한 단속 통계. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부 철도특별사법경찰대. Its tags are 철도경찰, 철도범죄, 철도안전법, 국토교통, 단속. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
